subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps & scheduling demo / loop in security + procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@finpath.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps & scheduling demo / loop in security + procurement

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: inline customer support assistant and automated compliance tagging for loan docs
- Important constraints: PII redaction, audit logs, and long-term retention policy for model outputs
- Key success metric: 50% reduction in average handle time for support workflows within 3 months

Next steps I propose:
1) 60–75 minute demo + technical deep dive with engineering and security (we'll show model behavior, architecture, and integration patterns)
2) Share SOC2 summary and SSO/KMS integrations for initial procurement review
3) Draft SOW and pricing ballpark after demo + tech alignment

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Mar 11, 10:00–11:15
- Thu Mar 11, 14:00–15:15
- Fri Mar 12, 09:00–10:15

Looping in Laura (sales engineer) for the demo and Rishi (security) + Dev (platform) to cover integration and security concerns. If those times don't work, send 2–3 times that do and we'll align.

Attachments: Redwood-Intro.pdf (brief product + architecture), SOC2-summary.docx (high-level controls)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & scheduling demo / loop in security + procurement

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, that matches our notes. We definitely want the full technical deep dive. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement will need a basic T&Cs timeline and a ballpark for committed monthly capacity; will loop in procurement lead Priya (cc'd).
- Security will want to validate SOC2 controls and have a short questionnaire; Samir (platform lead) will coordinate with your team on integration patterns.

Our availability (PST):
- Thu Mar 11, 14:00–15:30 (best)
- Fri Mar 12, 09:00–10:30

Can Laura and Rishi confirm the 14:00 slot? Also can you share SOC2 artifacts prior to the demo so our security team can pre-read?

Best,
Alex
Head of Product
FinPath

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@finpath.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & scheduling demo / loop in security + procurement

Alex / team —

Great — 14:00 Thu Mar 11 works on our side. I've sent a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (please accept).

Attaching: Redwood-Intro.pdf and SOC2-summary.docx for Priya & Samir to review. I've also attached a very high-level SOW-draft.pdf so procurement has something to look at before the demo.

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 5 min intros & goals
- 20 min product demo (Laura)
- 25 min technical deep dive + integration patterns (Dev + Laura)
- 15 min security & compliance Q&A (Rishi)
- 10 min next steps & procurement timeline (Marissa)

Action items before demo:
- Alex / Samir / Priya: share any specific compliance or integration checklist items you want covered (reply-all)
- Priya: if procurement needs a different SOW format, happy to adapt

Looking forward —
Marissa

[Attachment stubs: Redwood-Intro.pdf (7 pages), SOC2-summary.docx (3 pages), SOW-draft.pdf (2 pages)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@finpath.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & scheduling demo / loop in security + procurement

Thanks everyone — I've reviewed the SOC2 summary Marissa attached and will join the demo at 14:00. A couple notes for the demo thread:
- We'll want to see how logs/audit events are emitted and retention controls (please include any sample schema if available)
- Please prepare a short slide on encryption at rest / in transit and KMS integration patterns (1–2 slides).
- If you have a security questionnaire, feel free to drop it in the thread and I'll pre-answer where possible.

I'll be on the call and can coordinate follow-ups with Priya (procurement) after the demo for SOW and pricing alignment.

Rishi
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
